scope: P10 bounded seeking for finite YouTube tracks.
implemented: The authenticated PermSpeak-gated seek endpoint validates whole-second positions against the current track duration.
Live streams and unknown-duration tracks reject seeking with a client error.
Seeking cancels only the current media pipeline, preserves the stable queue entry, and replays that same item using a bounded yt-dlp download section.
Elapsed state begins at the selected offset and the accessible client range control exposes formatted position text.
The YouTube URL remains isolated after the option terminator and user input is never interpreted as a subprocess flag.
environment_observation: A later full go test ./... run executed and passed every emitted package except the root and repository test executables, which Windows Application Control blocked before execution. This is not recorded as a full-suite pass.
remaining: Real YouTube playback must verify audible seeking and timing accuracy against a running LiveKit room.
Packaged Windows keyboard and pointer interaction remains an acceptance gate.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
